<module id="multi_pipe_8bit">
    <description>Unsigned 8-bit multiplier implemented with pipelining.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="mul_en_in">Input enable signal that controls the multiplication operation.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[7:0]">Input signal representing the multiplicand with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[7:0]">Input signal representing the multiplier with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
        <output id="mul_en_out">Output enable signal indicating if the multiplication operation is enabled.</output>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[15:0]">Product output signal with a data width of 16 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="IDLE"/>
        <parameter name="LOAD"/>
        <parameter name="MULTIPLY"/>
        <parameter name="ACCUMULATE"/>
        <parameter name="OUTPUT"/>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="mul_en_out_reg" width="1"/> <!-- Register to hold the output enable signal -->
        <reg id="mul_a_reg" width="8"/> <!-- Register to hold the multiplicand -->
        <reg id="mul_b_reg" width="8"/> <!-- Register to hold the multiplier -->
        <wire id="temp" width="8" array_size="8"/> <!-- Wires to hold partial products -->
        <reg id="sum" width="9" array_size="8"/> <!-- Registers to hold partial sums -->
        <reg id="mul_out_reg" width="16"/> <!-- Register to hold the final product -->
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                mul_en_out_reg <= 1'b0;
                mul_a_reg <= 8'b0;
                mul_b_reg <= 8'b0;
                temp <= {8{8'b0}};
                sum <= {8{9'b0}};
                mul_out_reg <= 16'b0;
            end else begin
                case (current_state)
                    IDLE: begin
                        if (mul_en_in) begin
                            current_state <= LOAD;
                        end
                    end
                    LOAD: begin
                        mul_en_out_reg <= mul_en_in;
                        mul_a_reg <= mul_a;
                        mul_b_reg <= mul_b;
                        temp <= {8{8'b0}};
                        sum <= {8{9'b0}};
                        mul_out_reg <= 16'b0;
                        current_state <= MULTIPLY;
                    end
                    MULTIPLY: begin
                        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) begin
                            temp[i] <= mul_a_reg & (mul_b_reg >> i);
                        end
                        current_state <= ACCUMULATE;
                    end
                    ACCUMULATE: begin
                        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) begin
                            sum[i] <= sum[i] + temp[i];
                        end
                        current_state <= OUTPUT;
                    end
                    OUTPUT: begin
                        mul_out_reg <= sum[0][8:1] + sum[1][8:1] << 1 + sum[2][8:1] << 2 + sum[3][8:1] << 3 +
                                      sum[4][8:1] << 4 + sum[5][8:1] << 5 + sum[6][8:1] << 6 + sum[7][8:1] << 7;
                        current_state <= IDLE;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end

        assign mul_en_out = mul_en_out_reg[0];
        assign mul_out = mul_out_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
